description:
As a web developer, you have a server access log at /home/user/logs/access.log. You want to extract and view only the lines from this log file that refer to HTTP POST requests, so you can check for possible API usage patterns.

Please filter the /home/user/logs/access.log file to show only those lines containing the string "POST" as an HTTP method. The HTTP method is always located at the beginning of the quoted request part, following the format:

[IP address] - - [date/time] "METHOD URL HTTP/version" status size

For example, a valid line might look like:
192.168.1.5 - - [23/Jun/2024:15:10:55 +0000] "POST /api/login HTTP/1.1" 200 342

Your output must display only those log lines that represent POST requests (i.e., where "POST" appears as the method in the quoted request). Write the results to a new file located at /home/user/logs/post_requests.log.

The output file /home/user/logs/post_requests.log should contain only the full, unmodified text of each POST request line, one per line, and should not include any other log entries or additional information. Pay careful attention that only lines where "POST" is the first word inside the quoted request section are included.
